Extensions conventionally used for this format, leading dot included, lowercase. Purely informational; detection is driven by content.

Whether pixel decoding is implemented. When false the decoder still reports header facts through `TryIdentify` and `TryDecode` fails with [`NotImplemented`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.ApertureError~NotImplemented).

docs.summary: Decodes pixels. The base implementation reports [`NotImplemented`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.ApertureError~NotImplemented); override it together with [`CanDecodePixels`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.Decoders.PngDecoder~CanDecodePixels) once the codec exists.
Lifts whatever ancillary blocks the container carries. The default finds none, which is the right answer for a format that has nowhere to put them.

docs.summary: Reads the container header. Implementations must treat every field as hostile: bounds check before indexing, reject impossible geometry, and never loop on a value the file controls without a hard cap.
